TIE

Both responses cover the key points accurately, but both go over the 120-word limit. By my count, Response A runs to about 133 words and Response B to about 127, so neither meets the constraint.

A's headed layout is easier for a busy manager to skim and it names all three fixes. B is slightly closer to the limit, but it merges the fixes into a single clause. Neither advantage clearly outweighs the other, so I'm calling it a tie.
